title: Protect isolated baseline
description: Prepare controlled development target only after plan approval
objective: Keep all original components and client records recoverable
source_files: Audit inventory/backup/manifests; current tenderproof_os; tests/conftest.py; tenderproof/config.py
proposed_modifications: Refresh consistent backup and hashes; create isolated working copy; isolate runtime before any tests
risk_assessment: High data loss or test-pollution risk if copied paths resolve to live storage
expected_evidence: Fresh full inventory and backup digest; restored old schema/row fingerprints; frozen safety test hashes
verification_procedure: Compare all 340 current operational hashes and restored artifacts; verify no writes from isolated setup
acceptance_criteria: No original file changed; recoverable current snapshot; exact target and import/runtime roots recorded
human_approval_checkpoint: User accepts scope and recovery point before edits

title: Shared policy and additive schema
description: Specify common release authority and compatible migration
objective: Remove divergent decision rules while retaining existing interfaces
source_files: tenderproof/models.py; tenderproof/db.py; tenderproof/config.py; proposed decision_service.py and migrations.py
proposed_modifications: Add structured review/run/approval/journal records and deterministic current-input snapshots
risk_assessment: High cross-service and migration risk; avoid duplicate authority and legacy autoapproval
expected_evidence: Policy contract; schema diff; API comparison; rollback/idempotence/failure logs
verification_procedure: Fresh/historical/real-copy migration tests and cross-session stable fingerprints
acceptance_criteria: All old columns/values retained; transactional failure rollback; legacy evidence explicitly unreviewed
human_approval_checkpoint: Human review of eligibility semantics and migration design

title: Mandatory guard integration
description: Port only reviewed Release 011 scoring and review guards
objective: Prevent attractiveness score from overriding mandatory unresolved or failed conditions
source_files: bid_score_service.py; verification_service.py; audited three-file patch; tests/test_release_011.py
proposed_modifications: Preserve score thresholds; classify FAIL versus UNKNOWN; retain provisional scoring compatibility
risk_assessment: High decision-safety risk if Gap becomes invented FAIL or all recommendations are blocked
expected_evidence: S01-S05/S23 logs; unchanged seven-test provenance; score regression
verification_procedure: Execute guard parameterizations and control; compare public signatures
acceptance_criteria: All mandatory negatives block positive recommendation; S23 remains Pursue only as provisional advice
human_approval_checkpoint: Human confirms mandatory policy and provisional-versus-approved distinction

title: Source evidence and invalidation
description: Version inputs and validate attributable evidence applicability
objective: Prevent stale or unsupported evidence from supplying clearance
source_files: source_service.py; extraction_service.py; compliance_service.py; egp_service.py; decision_service.py; models.py
proposed_modifications: Hash/version raw and extracted inputs; record review/entity/validity/coverage; invalidate relevant writes; preserve original quotation
risk_assessment: High provenance and coverage risk; no phrase parser can certify actual document truth
expected_evidence: Source/evidence review examples; S06-S16 logs; expiry/entity/mixed-PDF/amendment recovery tests
verification_procedure: Inspect physical file hashes and controlled dates; mutate every included snapshot class; reopen database session
acceptance_criteria: No absent/expired/wrong-entity/unreviewed source support clears; reviewed corrected evidence can recover
human_approval_checkpoint: Human validates coverage exclusions and evidence review requirements

title: Verification and human authority
description: Retain history and protect release transitions
objective: Bind explicit human approval to exact successful current assessment
proposed_modifications: Append run snapshots/results; warning precedence; deny generic ready assignments; record approval/revocation
risk_assessment: High false-clearance risk; local reviewer names are not authenticated multi-user identity
expected_evidence: Run/review/approval history; S17/S19/S22/S24 results; protected-create and revocation tests
verification_procedure: Approve valid synthetic snapshot then mutate inputs/expire evidence/revoke; attempt readiness bypass
acceptance_criteria: No blocker overridden; warnings PRELIMINARY; no approval means not ready; no historical rows deleted
human_approval_checkpoint: Human approves local approval model and history controls

title: Workflow and output boundaries
description: Gate artifacts and workflow without removing draft generation
objective: Ensure stale/unapproved output never appears currently client-ready
proposed_modifications: Use current successful runs; version artifacts; hash/recheck release; literal untrusted spreadsheet text
risk_assessment: High client decision risk and filesystem/DB race risk; historical files must remain retained
expected_evidence: Approved positive MD/DOCX/XLSX flow; S18/S20/S21 tests; tamper/stale/download/race evidence
verification_procedure: Read actual artifacts and cell types; recheck after amendment during generation; confirm compensating rollback
acceptance_criteria: All sections/16 sheets retained; draft useful and labeled; current approved path works; stale release denied
human_approval_checkpoint: Human reviews blocked/draft/approved artifact wording and release behavior

title: Existing UI and launcher compatibility
description: Expose safety controls within existing pages and runbooks
objective: Keep founder operation familiar and local with no empty or removed pages
source_files: Existing ui verification/cases/tor_extraction/bid_scorecard/report_generator/exports/helpers/home; run_app.py; both launchers; README/QUICKSTART
proposed_modifications: Add minimal review/approval/history controls; derived status displays; isolated tests; read-only --check; compatible constraints
risk_assessment: Medium workflow and installation risk; no live dependency upgrades or app replacement
expected_evidence: Windows launcher logs; read-only check hashes; runtime path isolation; runbook operator notes
verification_procedure: Test paths containing spaces and ampersand; all flags/default invocation; clean candidate environment
acceptance_criteria: All 16 original navigation entries work; demo not auto-created; exact launcher artifacts retained
human_approval_checkpoint: Founder review of preserved workflows and supported runtime claims

title: Safety regression and recovery audit
description: Execute frozen probes plus risk-focused tests in isolation
objective: Produce reproducible decision-safety and preservation evidence
source_files: Frozen external 24-probe file; original 27 tests; seven Release 011 tests; focused new policy/migration tests
proposed_modifications: Add tests only as needed; never weaken original expected outcomes; generate logs outside operational tree
risk_assessment: High false-confidence risk if approval absence masks every other failed control
expected_evidence: Exact commands/exit codes/JUnit; positive approved fixtures per negative class; full old-value migration/restore comparison
verification_procedure: Run original/frozen/external suites separately; injected DDL failure; idempotence; restore; inspect all outputs
acceptance_criteria: 24/24 exact probes plus all old/new regressions pass; no hidden skip/xfail; recovery and unchanged original hashes proven
human_approval_checkpoint: QA reviews disputed expectations explicitly without weakening green criteria

title: Founder end-to-end and page acceptance
description: Verify execution and interaction beyond page rendering
objective: Preserve existing functionality and demonstrate usable safe workflows
source_files: app.py page registry; all 16 UI pages; Windows launchers; generated outputs
proposed_modifications: No feature expansion; complete isolated AppTest and browser/operator acceptance
risk_assessment: Medium risk that imports pass while review/download controls are broken
expected_evidence: 16-page AppTest; desktop/narrow browser records; positive and blocked/stale workflow outputs
verification_procedure: Create case; intake; requirements; compliance; CV; scoring; risks/method; review; approve; report/export/IP; invalidate; inspect history
acceptance_criteria: 16/16 render; actual controls and downloads work; stale artifact not current-ready; no live client data writes
human_approval_checkpoint: Named operator accepts tested workflow and limitations

title: Release evidence and merge checkpoint
description: Prepare recommendation only after technical acceptance
objective: Make eventual merge explicit reproducible and recoverable
source_files: Approved plan; candidate diffs/manifests; full gate evidence; fresh recovery point
proposed_modifications: Assemble per-file rationale/test/rollback ledger; document maintenance and paired recovery; request separate merge approval
risk_assessment: High risk of treating automated pass as authorization or losing newer data during recovery
expected_evidence: Complete change manifest with before/after hashes; evidence ledger; G01-G08 results; proposed deployment/rollback steps
verification_procedure: Reconcile every changed file against approved allowlist and evidence; verify recovery reference and owner decision
acceptance_criteria: G01-G08 passed and exact candidate/recovery package reviewed; no merge before named human authorization
human_approval_checkpoint: Separate explicit Syful merge authorization; e-GP expansion remains separate
